rows.english: Save a copy to your chosen location, then choose an app to share it. Your current Save destination stays unchanged.
rows.raw: AN Paint quicopina ixcopincayotl huan quiahcocui campa tictlapehpenqui. Teipan, pan Android, xictlapehpeni tlen tictequihuiz para tictitlaniz. AN Paint axquipatla campa quiahcocui quemman tictequihuia “Xicahcocui”.
rows.display: AN Paint quicopina ixcopincayotl huan quiahcocui campa tictlapehpenqui. Teipan, pan Android, xictlapehpeni tlen tictequihuiz para tictitlaniz. AN Paint axquipatla campa quiahcocui quemman tictequihuia “Xicahcocui”.
rows.backtranslation: AN Paint reproduces/copies the image and stores it where you chose. Then, in Android, choose what you will use in order to send it. AN Paint does not change where it stores it when you use “Save”.
rows.caller: The File menu passes share=true,export=true. It first encodes and writes the chosen destination, preserving the existing savedTarget; only then FileProvider/ACTION_SEND and Intent.createChooser are opened. User app selection and eventual delivery are not observed or guaranteed. Sharing allows all formats, so a copy can be a derived representation rather than a byte-identical editable document.
limits: The app is described functionally as what you will use in Android to send it. The caller opens the Android app chooser after saving; no independent native app noun or imagined button name is used. Independent review must judge this contextual paraphrase.

The first clause describes the app producing and storing the copy; it is not an instruction to invoke Copy all or another manual copy step. Reproduction does not mean a byte-identical or editable-project copy.
The send clause expresses purpose and user choice, not completion, confirmed receipt or guaranteed delivery. The Save-destination non-change remains explicit.
rows.confidence: moderate; own-source functional composition with explicit technical anchors and bounded paraphrases

rows.english: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
rows.raw: ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏊ: ᎪᏪᎸ — ᎤᏍᎪᏍᏗᏴ — ᏧᏓᎴᎾᎢ → ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ — ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎸ. ᎲᏓ: Monospace — ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏙᏪᎵᏍᎩ. ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏊ → ᎠᎴᏅᏗᏍᎬ — ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ — ᎯᏍᏚᎢ: ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
rows.display: ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏊ: ᎪᏪᎸ — ᎤᏍᎪᏍᏗᏴ — ᏧᏓᎴᎾᎢ → ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ — ᎢᏯᏓᏛᏁᎸ. ᎲᏓ: Monospace — ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏙᏪᎵᏍᎩ. ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩᏊ → ᎠᎴᏅᏗᏍᎬ — ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ — ᎯᏍᏚᎢ: ᏰᎵ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
rows.backtranslation: Plain text: character brightness differences make an image representation. Use a Monospace font. Plain text → original/base image → Open: impossible.
rows.caller: SaveOptionsDialog101 ASCII_ART explanation. TextImageCodec40–52 scales the bitmap to a character grid, and TextImageData167–184 maps displayed luma to sparse/dense marks. This exports an appearance in text, not a byte-encoded recoverable original image.
limits: Authored compact noun/topic hierarchy and explicit arrows, not attested full prose or newly guessed finite grammar.

Character is singular source category used to describe the class of marks. Brightness difference names perceived glyph density/lightness rather than coloured foreground text, changing monitor settings, daylight or low physical weight. Selection is implemented by luma ramp; plain text contains no colour attributes.

Monospace is a technical family identifier supported by official Android documentation, not claimed Cherokee lexical attestation. Recommendation of fixed-advance font does not promise all glyph ink widths equal.

The final arrow starts from this plain-text rendition and targets original-image opening. It does not say the original source file was destroyed or cannot itself be opened, and does not claim universally impossible reconstruction by any external process.
The result is a visual representation. The compact output category supplies plain-text creation without an invented write conjugation.

rows.english: Higher quality preserves more detail and usually makes a larger file.
rows.raw: Ica se número cati más hueyi ipan Quality, AN Paint quiajocui más cati nesi ipan ixkopinali. Miyac huelta, pero amo nochipa, monequi más bytes para quiajocuis.
rows.display: Ica se número cati más hueyi ipan Quality, AN Paint quiajocui más cati nesi ipan ixkopinali. Miyac huelta, pero amo nochipa, monequi más bytes para quiajocuis.
rows.backtranslation: With a higher number in Quality, AN Paint stores more of what is visible in the image. Many times, but not always, more bytes are needed to store it.
rows.caller: SaveOptionsDialog102 shows this for JPEG and HEIC. The Quality control84 is a numeric slider1–100. ImageExporter uses that quality for JPEG compression or HEIC encoding, with HEIC lossless false. rows.english: Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Lossless keeps every colour value.
rows.raw: Ica se número cati más hueyi ipan Quality, miyac huelta, pero amo nochipa, monequi más bytes para AN Paint quiajocuis ixkopinali. Ica Lossless, AN Paint quiajocui sesen número RGB ipan ixkopinali huan amo quipata.
rows.display: Ica se número cati más hueyi ipan Quality, miyac huelta, pero amo nochipa, monequi más bytes para AN Paint quiajocuis ixkopinali. Ica Lossless, AN Paint quiajocui sesen número RGB ipan ixkopinali huan amo quipata.
rows.backtranslation: With a higher number in Quality, many times, but not always, more bytes are needed for AN Paint to store the image. With Lossless, AN Paint stores each RGB number in the image and does not change it.
rows.caller: SaveOptionsDialog103 default is visibly used for JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. PNG selects the text but hides the explanation105. Lossless selection hides the quality slider89; the explanation remains. Each numerical colour value must remain unchanged, not all values equal. HeifCodec91 scopes AVIF to exact opaque RGB coding; no metadata, whole-file, animation or source-alpha guarantee.
